text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for lending me your notebook! 
Your notes were so beautifully organized, 
Flight-san, I was truly impressed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even the color choices are so stylish! 
With a notebook like this, it must be so 
fun to look back on your notes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ I'm so glad your heart fluttered!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've been taking notes on things I notice 
in my "Chiyo-Note" too. May I refer to 
your writing style for ideas?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's good, but... I think there might 
be a method that suits you even better, 
Chiyono O-chan!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-chan's style is all about notes 
of excitement and discoveries. In that 
case, how about an outfit like this?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Draw a vertical line in the notebook: 
normal notes on the left, and any comments 
or maxims you like on the right. Just like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's like the Chiyo-Notebook has 
been reborn! Let's see here...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Thread the warp through the weft’— Yeah, 
this looks like it'll turn out great! 
Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're very welcome♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What should I do? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san told me... that she wanted to 
improve the "Library Committee 
Recommendations" section in the library 
newsletter...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So Rice was trying to think with you 
too... But... Rice was no help at all...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! In that case, how about we 
style up the 'Library Committee 
Recommendations' corner to make it shine!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The key is giving form to that thrilling, 
sparkling feeling you get when you read 
it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
How about conveying the book's vibe 
through the frame design and font, or 
adding a brief handwritten review?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... If it's like that, maybe Rice can 
do it too...! I-I'll give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nwoooooo!! A truly Bakushin-level 
criiiisis!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then let's try replacing x in this 
quadratic function with carrots, and y 
with Bakushin O's stamina!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The more carrots she has, the more stamina 
Bakushin O will have, right...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"It increases, doesn't it?! I see! A 
quadratic function means that the more 
carrots you eat, the more you Bakushin 
Bakushin...! It all makes sense now!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've somehow managed to finish my 
assignment, so I'm off to submit it to the 
staff room!! Bakushin, bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acquired sample of rich emotional 
expression to aid in mission completion. 
Initiating trace. Bakushin, Bakushin—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Master a dance that brings joy to 
people." That is the mission assigned to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I collected samples from 
emotionally expressive Umamusume and 
traced them. Is there a problem with 
that...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. I'm sure there's an outfit that 
suits Bourbon-chan best.”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-chan's greatest strength is her 
sharpness! If you hone that to perfection, 
your fans are sure to love it♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"To truly develop one's potential, one 
must use a method that suits them. I 
understand. Thank you for guiding me from 
this new perspective."

text_block_list.name: Flight's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! Flight-chan taught me how to 
plate food. Doesn't it look lovely, just 
like at a restaurant?

text_block_list.name: Flight's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! Flight-chan really is so 
reliable. Maybe I should ask her for some 
outfit advice too?

While walking down the hallway, I 
overheard some students talking about 
North Flight. It sounds like her 
classmates really rely on her.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're in high spirits! Did 
something good happen?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I haven't done anything special. 
There was simply a wonderful gem right 
before my eyes, and I couldn't resist 
making it shine♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything troubling you as well, 
Trainer? If it's something I can help 
with, just say the word!

This seems like a great opportunity to 
deepen my bond with North Flight. What 
should I consult her about?

I'm planning to throw a birthday party for 
an old friend soon. When I mentioned that 
I had already bought a present and cake, 
but felt like it needed one more special 
touch...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about handing them an 
invitation? It's perfect for creating a 
special atmosphere for the day!
choice_data_list: An invitation, huh...? Sounds pretty good!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then we'll have to prepare a 
wonderful card.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you to my favorite stationery 
shop next time. Please let me help you 
pick out a card♪

North Flight has fun and thinks things 
through herself. I understood that people 
rely on her not just because she's 
dependable, but because of her positive 
attitude.

Lately, I've been paying attention to my 
room's decor, but it still feels rather 
austere. When I asked if there was any way 
to improve it...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about changing the 
curtains, or putting up some seasonal 
decorations?
choice_data_list: In that case, it sounds pretty easy to do!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the next time I visit your room, 
Trainer, please let me help! If we're 
doing this, I want to do a full makeover 
coordinate♪

North Flight herself is enjoying it more 
than anyone. I understood then why 
everyone feels so comfortable coming to 
her for advice.
